name: Huffman Entropy Coder
description: PHF Huffman entropy coder (T = u8/u16/u32). Lossless. Multi-kernel coarse encode path with a CPU prefix-sum sync. Byte-transparent output.

config.name: bklen
config.description: Codebook length (distinct symbols). Default 256 for u8, 1024 for u16/u32. Must be <= 2^(8*sizeof(T)).

config.name: encodeMode
config.description: Coarse = the supported multi-kernel path with CPU sync. Fine is experimental: it requires all codes to fit in 8 bits and silently falls back to Coarse otherwise, which is what happens on realistic data.

paper.title: cuSZ: An Error-Bounded Lossy Compressor for GPU Scientific Data
